purpose: Calibration of physical full GI recomputation cost after a rigid geometry change (Cycles, RTX 5080). Not a neural-method experiment.
pre_protocol_observations: Before this file was written, smoke runs on the original scene were seen: a 16-spp 1920x1080 render took ~1.9 s in a fresh process and ~0.22 s path tracing with persistent data; evaluated triangle count 699,800; Cycles geometry memory ~10.6 MB and texture memory ~66 MB (--cycles-print-stats).
The G1 transform below was chosen from a 32-spp half-resolution preview and a top view (collision and visibility check), before any timing at the protocol settings.

scene_source.name: BMW27 (Mike Pan), official Blender demo/benchmark file
scene_source.file_version: 2.77 (converted on load by Blender 5.1.0; the original file is never saved)
scene_source.note: bmw27_cpu.blend (sha256 4f0a12ee...) differs only in tile settings and is not used.

render_contract.compositing_justification: The file's compositor (glare, blur, bokeh image overlay, colour balance) is image post-processing, not light transport; it is disabled so the timed path ends at the Cycles Combined pass. Its cost is reported once separately.
render_contract.unchanged_as_loaded: camera and its depth of field, lights, world, materials, light tree flag (False in the converted file), caustics, clamping, pixel filter, tiling, view-layer passes

mover.description: Rear BMW: an empty instancing collection 1M (the same collection whose real objects are the front BMW). Moving it moves only the rear car.
mover.G0: location and rotation as loaded (recorded at run time)
mover.transport_rationale: brings the rear car ~2 m from the front car and partly under the emission panel: changes body-to-body reflections, floor shadowing between the cars and the light the rear car returns to the front car

persistent_data_modes.on: render.use_persistent_data = True: the Cycles session survives between renders and only updated data is re-synchronised (Blender's incremental final-render path). Primary.
persistent_data_modes.off: fresh Cycles session per render: full export, full BVH build. Secondary.

repetitions.sequence: cold render in G0; warm-up frames alternating G1,G0; steady frames alternating (every steady frame follows a mover change); static frames re-render without change (control)
repetitions.statistics: first, median, mean, min, max, p25, p75 per phase; headline = steady median; cold reported separately; no fastest-run selection

warmup_policy: one Blender process per condition; the first render in the process is the cold render (OptiX kernels from the precompiled sm_120 cubin and the warm OptiX disk cache); two warm-up frames follow and are reported but excluded from steady statistics

timing_fields.B_cold_setup_s: cold render: Cycles total - path tracing
timing_fields.E_device_update_s: Cycles total - render-without-sync - D (BVH/IAS build or refit plus all other device managers; not separable at debug log level)
timing_fields.F_path_trace_s: Cycles render-scheduler Path Tracing wall time
timing_fields.G_frame_total_s: C + wall time of bpy.ops.render.render (includes Blender render-pipeline overhead)
timing_fields.derived: effective_fps = 1/G; gap_30fps = G_ms/33.333; gap_60fps = G_ms/16.667; also reported for Cycles total and path tracing alone

memory_fields.cpu: process working set / peak working set / private bytes (GetProcessMemoryInfo)
memory_fields.gpu: whole-GPU memory.used polled by nvidia-smi every 0.2 s, reported as peak minus the pre-launch baseline (per-process GPU memory is not available under WDDM); maximum of the Cycles render_stats 'Mem:' figure over each render (Cycles-tracked device allocations: scene data, BVH, render buffers, path states)

xl_policy.trigger: BMW27 is classified lightweight on the RTX 5080 if its logical triangle count is below 5,000,000 AND its Cycles device scene memory (geometry + textures, --cycles-print-stats) is below 10% of the GPU's 16 GB. These are workload-scale properties, not timing outcomes.
xl_policy.trigger_inputs_known_at_declaration: 699,800 triangles; ~77 MB geometry+texture -> XL is built
xl_policy.unit: bay = front car + rear car + one emission panel, laid out exactly as in the original
xl_policy.instanced: added cars are collection instances of 1M (unique geometry unchanged, logical geometry grows)
xl_policy.realized: added cars converted to real objects (duplicates_make_real); each carries its own modifier stack, so evaluated geometry is no longer shared

camera.rule: copy of the original camera data (sensor, f-stop); original azimuth; looks at the grid centre

xl_policy.unchanged: materials, shaders, panel/world strength, render settings; bay (0,0) is the original scene and holds the mover
xl_policy.stop_rule: stop at the first level that fails to build or render (OOM, Cycles error) or whose build process exceeds 48 GB working set; that level is recorded as the practical capacity boundary and larger levels of the same mode are not attempted
xl_policy.visible_elements: every car is checked by camera ray casts to 9 probe points; counts of cars visible and in frame are reported

evidence_images.stationary_mask: pixels whose depth is equal in G0 and G1 (relative difference < 1e-4): first hit unchanged
evidence_images.transport_change: mean |G1-G0| on the stationary mask compared with mean |G0 seed0 - G0 seed1|
